name: Customer support triage
description: A support message comes in. Does it report a problem now? Which team gets it? How upset is the customer? For an upset customer: is the customer angry, or unable to work?

urgent.instructions: Does the customer report a problem that is happening now?

criteria.true: Something is broken, blocked or charged wrongly right now
criteria.false: A question, a request or a thank-you

team.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

human.instructions: Is the customer angry, or unable to work?

examples.query: I was charged twice this month, please refund me now!!!
How do I reset my password?
The app crashes every time I open it. This is the third time I write. Unacceptable.
Can I get a quote for 50 seats?
Your API returns 500 errors, our production is down
